lines.say: Protein powder. Do you actually need it?
Whey is made from milk. It's the liquid left over when cheese is made.
It's dried into a powder. So it's food, not magic.
It digests fast and is packed with leucine, the amino acid that switches on muscle building.
But your muscles can't tell a shake from a chicken breast.
What matters is your total protein for the day.
If food gets you there, you don't need it. If it doesn't, a shake is an easy top up.
Lactose trouble? Try whey isolate or a plant protein.
